aToB.memory: Sitting near Finn in Potions Class means enduring rapid-fire questions about every glowing gizmo on Mina's belt—and watching him magically appear outside the Aetherium Workshop whenever a capacitor pops loudly enough to rattle glass. Mina actually loves explaining how her inventions work to him, though she has learned that offhand jokes become bold campus headlines by Friday.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Mina wants to geek out briefly with Finn over the optical enchantment inside his battered brass bellows camera—while making sure he doesn't exaggerate last night's tiny blue workshop spark into a front-page disaster.

bToA.memory: Finn adores Mina because unlike tight-lipped upperclassmen, she genuinely loves showing off weird inventions—provided nobody tips off Celestia or Headmistress Sterling about her off-hours tests. Plus, Mina knows half of Starlight Tower's gossip purely by proximity, and her obsession with non-magical Earth technology makes her an instant lead on the Leo Vance beat.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to corner Mina over a pastry near Familiar's Perch Cafe, let her inspect his brass camera shutter, and ask what she's discovered so far about Leo Vance's Earth smartphone and anomalous resonance.
